fun_facts: Cam Skattebo is from Rio Linda, California.
As a little kid, Cam Skattebo got the nickname “Houdini” because he could escape from car seats.
Cam Skattebo began college at Sacramento State, then transferred to Arizona State before 2023.
In 2024, Cam Skattebo piled up 2,316 yards from scrimmage and 24 touchdowns, and finished fifth in Heisman Trophy voting.
Against BYU in 2024, Cam Skattebo ran for 147 yards and three touchdowns; after the third, he autographed the football.

basis.reasoning: The NFL player profile lists Arizona State as Cam Skattebo’s college.

# After fans storm field early, No. 21 Arizona St stops Hail Mary try for 28-23 win over No. 14 BYU

play

Cam Skattebo celebrates 3rd TD by autographing football (0:30)

Arizona State's Cam Skattebo immediately autographs a football after scoring his third rushing touchdown of the game. (0:30)

* AP

Nov 23, 2024, 08:30 PM ET

* Copy Link

* [Print](https://www.espn.com/espn/print?id=42570404)

TEMPE, Ariz. -- — [Cam Skattebo](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4696981/cam-skattebo) was the workhorse once again for Arizona State, carrying the Sun Devils on his back by rushing for 147 yards and three touchdowns. His reward was a well-earned celebration with fans.

Twice.

Skattebo had another big game, [Sam Leavitt](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5078810/sam-leavitt) threw for 247 yards and No. 21 Arizona State held on in the final minutes to beat No. 14 BYU 28-23 on Saturday.
